public_health_question.v: When and where did wastewater surveillance first detect evidence of the Omicron variant in U.S. communities, relative to clinical case detection?

ev.q: This report describes the initial detections in wastewater during November 21–December 16, 2021, and the interpretative framework for these types of data.
Early Evidence of the SARS-CoV-2 B.1.1.529 (Omicron) Variant in Community Wastewater
Early warning systems, such as sewage (wastewater) surveillance, † can help track the spread of SARS-CoV-2 variants across communities
The Houston Health Department conducts weekly wastewater testing at 39 sewersheds in the city and uses sequencing to track variants.
